## Pages

- [Fitaa Creative](https://fitaacreative.com/): services, selected work for brands in Accra, and the enquiry form.
- [Fully Booked by Fitaa](https://fitaacreative.com/fully-booked): direct booking setup for short-let hosts and beauty studios in Accra. Google Business Profile, WhatsApp Business, a click-to-chat link, a review QR card and a premium booking page. Get Found GHS 1,500 (live in 5 days), Get Chosen GHS 3,500 (live in 7 days), Stay Booked GHS 1,200 a month. Live in 7 days, or 50% of your fee back.
